text.formatted: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
text.plain: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

text.formatted: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't Incapacitated.
text.plain: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't Incapacitated.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
